items.note: The letter is addressed to "Dear Ms. Alvarez."
Apartment 4B appears in the subject, the body and the signature.
It says the heater "stopped working on October 2."
It says "I called you about it on October 3 and haven't heard back."
It says "Overnight temperatures are now in the 40s °F."
It asks for the repair "within 48 hours of receiving this email," and the subject line repeats the deadline.
It says "Section 12 of my lease requires the landlord to provide heat."
The tone is courteous and offers to arrange access. The firmness comes from the clear deadline and the lease citation.
Rent is never mentioned, and there are no threats.
About 110 words including the subject and signature, which is under the 150-word limit.
